duration: Fixed-term, 2 years from the start date, renewable by mutual agreement of the parties.

financial_value.payment_terms: Monthly salary plus a monthly housing allowance of SAR 2,000.

termination_clauses: Either party may terminate with 60 days' prior written notice.
penalty_clauses: A penalty equivalent to one month's salary applies if the Employee terminates without observing the notice period.
governing_law: Laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia; jurisdiction of the Riyadh Commercial Court.
language_precedence_clause: In case of conflict, the English version shall prevail.
